# which also enforces ordering and prevents duplicate parts.
_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"P"
    r"(?:(?P<years>[0-9]+)Y)?"
    r"(?:(?P<months>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<weeks>[0-9]+)W)?"
    r"(?:(?P<days>[0-9]+)D)?"
    r"(?:"
    r"T"
    r"(?:(?P<hours>[0-9]+)H)?"
    r"(?:(?P<minutes>[0-9]+)M)?"
    r"(?:(?P<seconds>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)S)?"
    r")?"

_DATE_PARTS = ("years", "months", "weeks", "days")
_TIME_PARTS = ("hours", "minutes", "seconds")


def parse(text: str) -> Duration:
    """Parse an ISO 8601 duration."""
    match = _PATTERN.fullmatch(text)
    if match is None:
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")

    values = match.groupdict()
    if not any(values[name] is not None for name in _DATE_PARTS + _TIME_PARTS):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")
    if "T" in text and not any(values[name] is not None for name in _TIME_PARTS):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid ISO 8601 duration: {text!r}")

    return Duration(

        months=int(values["months"] or 0),
        weeks=int(values["weeks"] or 0),
        days=int(values["days"] or 0),
        hours=int(values["hours"] or 0),
        minutes=int(values["minutes"] or 0),
        seconds=float(values["seconds"] or 0),
    )

    """Format seconds without float noise or exponent notation."""
    if seconds == int(seconds):
        return str(int(seconds))

    # representation noise (e.g. 0.1 + 0.2 -> "0.3") while retaining ample
    # precision for duration values.
    text = format(seconds, ".15g")
    if "e" in text or "E" in text:
        text = format(Decimal(text), "f")
    return text


def format(duration: Duration) -> str:
    """Write ``duration`` in canonical ISO 8601 form."""
    date_parts = []
    if duration.years:
        date_parts.append(f"{duration.years}Y")
    if duration.months:
        date_parts.append(f"{duration.months}M")
    if duration.weeks:
        date_parts.append(f"{duration.weeks}W")
    if duration.days:
        date_parts.append(f"{duration.days}D")

    time_parts = []
    if duration.hours:

    if duration.minutes:
        time_parts.append(f"{duration.minutes}M")
    if duration.seconds:

    result = "P" + "".join(date_parts)
    if time_parts:
        result += "T" + "".join(time_parts)
    return result

    """``moment`` plus ``duration``."""
    month_index = (
        moment.year * 12 + (moment.month - 1)
        + duration.years * 12 + duration.months
    )

    return moment + timedelta(
        weeks=duration.weeks,
        days=duration.days,
        hours=duration.hours,
        minutes=duration.minutes,
        seconds=duration.seconds,
    )
